assign.request: click a cell inside a flex/grid leaf and the rail shows that item's own words; the words persist on the panel and land as CSS on the item; proven headless; docs current
steps: read persist.js, glyphs.js, properties.js, text.js, focus.js, templates.js, display.css
render item rows in properties.js under leaf rows
persist per-item words keyed by cell index, land as CSS custom props
add display.css rule block reading the custom props
headless probe: select, set words, verify computed CSS, repaint/hydrate persistence, Escape

assign.now: functional probe: select cell, set words, verify computed CSS + persistence

log.msg: ITEM_WORDS in glyphs.js; item selection wired into text.js's existing click delegation (piggybacks the same body-level listener, no touch to overlays.js/workspace.js/focus.js — focus.js now owned by a concurrent task per coordinator); persist.js hosts item_of/set_item/items_apply (30 lines, under the 40-line budget, no new items.js needed); cells stamps data-cell; display.css lands --item-* vars on the child + .panel-item-on ring; tools.js gets one panel-item listener mirroring panel-focus; zero console errors on /framework/ext/Panel/ and /demo/ so far

assign.outcome:
**Landed — items inside a flex/grid leaf are selectable, the rail shows their own words, and they persist as CSS on the child.** Click a cell twice (leaf first, then its item) and grow/basis/order/self (flex) or span/row-span/self (grid) appear under the leaf's own rows in [the rail](/framework/ext/Panel/) — a word writes straight onto the live cell (no repaint, no dropped selection) and survives a template repaint, a `toJSON` → `hydrate` round-trip, and Escape (item first, then the leaf, unchanged). No subclass: an item is an element with words, not a Panel — [doc/decisions.md](/framework/ext/Panel/doc/decisions/), [doc/focus.md](/framework/ext/Panel/doc/focus/), [doc/words.md](/framework/ext/Panel/doc/words/).

![item selected](./item-selected.png)

Measured headless: `grow 2` → `flexGrow` `"2"` on cell 3 only (cell 1 stays `"0"`); `self center` → `alignSelf` `"center"`; grid `span 2` → `gridColumnStart` `"span 2"`; zero console errors on the Panel page and its demo tab.

Left deliberately: item drag-reorder (next); multi-select across cells (same open question panels themselves already have); a cosmetic collision where the rail can show two rows both tagged "self" at once (the leaf's own placement and the item's) — noted in decisions.md, not fixed.
